context:
Goal: the written rules say the same as your ruling on when merges resume after a revert, so no session reads the old wording.
Problem (rule): two rule lines still say merges resume "until the revert's run on main is green": CLAUDE.md line 54 and skills/ci-hygiene/SKILL.md line 61. Your ruling own-745-b-resume-at-revert (and item 622 b) says merges resume when the revert merges. Rule-file edits need your word, and your grant covers only the act it names.
Based on (read): the coordinator's note 16:13 CST Nov 13, from lane red-main-owner-two-picks (replacement branch red-main-resume-at-revert-2); ruling own-745-b-resume-at-revert on the roadmap branch. Triage has not read the two lines or the lane's PR text.
Departs from: main — both lines say a green run on main after the revert; this changes them to the revert's merge. The exact new wording is the lane's, shown in its PR for your yes.
Meanwhile: the lane builds its PR as a draft; the two rule-file edits wait for your yes.
